# KOVO-HOLUB Nepomuk s.r.o.

> Czech family-owned engineering and metalworking manufacturer founded in 1927 (celebrating 100 years in 2027), producing custom DIN containers, commercial truck bodies and bespoke steel structures in Záhoří near Nepomuk for the Czech Republic, Germany, the Netherlands, France and Austria.

## Core Facts
- **Company:** KOVO-HOLUB Nepomuk s.r.o. (Company ID: 26364891, VAT: CZ26364891)
- **Founded:** 1927 (3rd generation family leadership — František & Jan Holub)
- **Location:** Záhoří 38, 335 01 Nepomuk, Czech Republic (49.459858, 13.615386)
- **Certifications & Norms:** ISO 9001, TÜV, DIN 30722 (Abroll), DIN 30720, certified visual weld inspection & towbar installation
- **Track Record:** 1,400+ completed B2B orders (clients include Eurovia, TSR Czech Republic, Faiveley Transport, RTS Nederland, ENGL Maschinen, Klaus Timber)
- **Key CNC Machinery:** Bystronic Hämmerle 150 3P CNC press brake (3000 mm / 160 t), 3m CNC guillotine shears (1–10 mm), 2m shears (12 mm), Pegas 300×320 SHI-LR band saw, MIG/TIG stainless & aluminium welding, shot blasting booths
- **Contact:** +420 602 237 112 / +420 371 591 644 · f.holub@kovo-holub.cz
